name: ErrorState
description: What to show when a page or a panel could not be shown: a failed load, or a 404, 403 or 500 screen, with what happened and how to go on.

title.description: Say what happened, e.g. "We could not load your invoices".

description.description: Why it happened and what the person can do.

icon.description: An icon above the title. Decorative. Without an icon or a code a warning icon is shown.

code.description: A status code such as 404, shown large above the title.

actions.description: What to do next: a Retry button, a link back.

variant.description: inline for inside a card or table; page for a whole screen.

headingLevel.description: Heading level of the title, 1 to 6. Use 1 when the error is the whole page.

announce.description: Announce it to screen readers (role alert). Turn it on only when the error appears after the page has loaded.

classNames.description: Extra class names for single parts, so you can restyle one part without editing the file. Keys: root, icon, code, title, description, actions.

requirements: The title is a real heading
With announce the region has role alert and is read when it appears; without it nothing is announced, so a page that loaded with an error does not shout
The icon is decorative; the words carry the message, never the color
screenReader: With announce: "Alert. We could not load your invoices."
Without: read in order as a heading, text and buttons

use_when: A request failed and you want to offer a retry
avoid_when: A single field is wrong: use the field's error message
A short message over working content: use Alert
anti_patterns: Showing the raw error text from the server
Setting announce on a page that loaded with the error

contract.data: A title and description in plain words, and the actions for what to do next.
